reason: Proved by induction on the number r of alternating steps, in the stronger form valid for every input length n simultaneously. For r=1 the totals of U(x) and D(x) are explicit: coefficients are n,n-1,...,1 and their reverse. For the inductive step, use the coefficient vector v for length n+1 and r steps, then define the new length n vector by w_i = sum_{k=1}^{n+1-i} v_k. These are positive integers and strictly decreasing because w_i-w_{i+1}=v_{n+1-i}>0. Substituting z=U(x) for the plus-start case and z=D(x) for the minus-start case yields exactly the two required formulas.
